_note: All 213 existing recipes are to be deleted. Action required per table:

recipe_ingredients.action: CASCADE DELETE (handled automatically by SQLAlchemy relationship cascade='all, delete-orphan')

meal_logs.action: SET recipe_id = NULL where recipe_id IN (1..213)
meal_logs.reason: meal_logs has no ON DELETE CASCADE for recipe_id — rows must be nulled manually
meal_logs.sql: UPDATE meal_logs SET recipe_id = NULL WHERE recipe_id BETWEEN 1 AND 213;

meal_plans.action: DEACTIVATE (set is_active = False) all meal_plans that reference old recipe IDs in their plan_data JSON
meal_plans.reason: plan_data is a JSON blob containing recipe dicts — we cannot fix it without re-generating plans. Deactivating forces a fresh plan on next login.
meal_plans.sql: UPDATE meal_plans SET is_active = FALSE WHERE created_at < NOW();

recipes.action: DELETE FROM recipes WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 213
recipes.sql: DELETE FROM recipes WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 213;
